findings.how_to_check: In Stata, execute MATCHING/1c_tgt_divided_files.do while divided_file1940_tgt_cleaned is already present on disk; verify that tgt_flag1940.dta has its timestamp updated and is overwritten before the script exits with error code 602. Inspection of lines 41-58 confirms no pre-existence check on flags precedes line 48.
findings.suggested_fix: Move the existence preflight checks before line 41. Verify with 'capture confirm file `\"`flags'\"'' and 'direxists(st_local(\"dst\"))' that neither tgt_flag1940.dta nor divided_file1940_tgt_cleaned exists before loading data or executing save, halting with error 602 if either is present.
findings.title: The standalone divided-file builder overwrites the target flag before checking whether outputs exist
findings.what_the_code_does: MATCHING/1c_tgt_divided_files.do executes 'save `\"`flags'\"', replace' at line 48 without any prior existence test. The subsequent preflight check at lines 53-58 only verifies 'direxists(st_local(\"dst\"))' and never checks whether tgt_flag1940.dta already exists, contradicting the comment at line 53 stating that both dst and the flag file must not exist yet.
findings.why_it_matters: While the master driver MATCHING/_tgt_only_run.do guards the flag file at startup, invoking or resuming MATCHING/1c_tgt_divided_files.do directly will silently replace tgt_flag1940.dta. If divided_file1940_tgt_cleaned already exists, the script overwrites tgt_flag1940.dta and then aborts with error 602, leaving an updated flag file alongside older intermediate and linkage files.

review_limits: No paper draft was supplied; claims-vs-code review was limited to internal script headers, comments, and the review brief (review/briefs/2026-11-17-target-only-links.md).
External census datasets and multi-gigabyte intermediate files reside outside the repository and were not queried, precluding independent calculation of exact target and link counts.
The Stata matching pipeline and user-written commands (abematch, abeclean) were not executed; conclusions reflect source analysis and documented Stata semantics.
The review was scoped to the uncommitted working-tree diff and untracked files in the MATCHING directory rather than a full-repository audit.
structured_output.summary: The round-two revisions successfully resolve the major defects from the previous review: the target flag now implements the canonical definition from census1940_all_labeled_data.dta, the console log distinguishes target records with and without model transcriptions, and the driver script enforces strict preflight guards on all final and intermediate outputs. One minor replication defect remains: running MATCHING/1c_tgt_divided_files.do directly overwrites tgt_flag1940.dta before checking whether the destination directory exists. Moving that check before the flag save ensures complete standalone safety.

verified_clean.evidence: The target flag is built from census1940_all_labeled_data.dta with asserted identifier uniqueness (isid histid) and uses the canonical expression !(namefrst==namefrst_fs & namelast==namelast_fs) at MATCHING/1c_tgt_divided_files.do:40-44.
verified_clean.item: The target flag now uses the canonical paper definition without blank exclusions or duplicate downgrades

verified_clean.evidence: MATCHING/_tgt_only_run.do:21-44 asserts that neither final link file (link1930_1940_{mltgt1940,ml1940}_cleaned_noraceblock0.dta), none of the three intermediate directories (divided_file1940_tgt_cleaned, r_ans_cleaned_tgt_cleaned1930_1940, r_ans_cleaned_true_cleaned1930_1940), nor tgt_flag1940.dta exists before executing any code.
verified_clean.item: The driver script enforces preflight guards across all final and intermediate products

verified_clean.evidence: MATCHING/1c_tgt_divided_files.do:108-118 explicitly tracks and displays both total target records (ntgt) and target records receiving model names (ntgtml), documenting that targets lacking model output retain Ancestry names.
verified_clean.item: Console logging and documentation accurately distinguish target coverage from model-name presence

verified_clean.evidence: MATCHING/1c_tgt_divided_files.do:60-71 sorts and compares birthplace file lists using ': list fT === fA', while lines 81-89 enforce 'isid id' and require 'merge 1:1 id using ans, assert(3) nogen'.
verified_clean.item: Birthplace file sets and record-level identifier uniqueness are strictly verified across sources

verified_clean.evidence: MATCHING/1c_tgt_divided_files.do:90-95 assigns tgt=0 to records unmatched in the flag file while preserving row counts, and lines 97-101 and 120-124 halt with error 459 if any record with name_true_cleaned_exists==0 differs from _ans_cleaned.
verified_clean.item: Unmatched flag records and missing-model fallbacks are handled without data loss or silent mismatches

verified_clean.evidence: In MATCHING/3_append_and_clean_all_links_christian_torbenV2.do:86-90, the ver tag is constructed solely from fstype and fs_years when ml_years is empty, ensuring identical filenames and output for existing FamilySearch workflows.
verified_clean.item: FamilySearch-only stage-three append logic and file naming remain unchanged

verified_clean.evidence: MATCHING/3_append_and_clean_all_links_christian_torbenV2.do:129-140 merges mi_true_cleaned for both _true_cleaned and _tgt_cleaned name types, enforces assert _merge==3, and renames variables symmetrically.
verified_clean.item: Middle initial extraction and merge assertions in stage 3 guarantee 100% record matching

verified_clean.item: Common execution pipeline ensures strict comparability between target-only and all-record link outputs

summary.description: Two to four sentences. The overall state of the reviewed work and the single most important thing to fix. No preamble.

dimensions_reviewed.description: Which scope dimensions were actually reviewed in this run.

findings.description: Defects and concerns, ordered most severe first. Empty if none. Do not pad with stylistic observations.

severity.description: blocker: a reported result is wrong. major: a referee would demand it. minor: real but survivable. nit: cosmetic.

confidence.description: verified: traced in the source. likely: strongly implied but depends on unseen data. speculative: a question, not an established defect.

title.description: One line, stating the defect itself, not its category.

location.description: path:line, or path:line-line. Several may be comma-separated. Required: a finding without a location is not a finding.

what_the_code_does.description: Precisely what the code computes, quoting the relevant expression. Contrast with what it was evidently intended to compute.

why_it_matters.description: The consequence for a number or claim in the paper. If there is no consequence, the severity is nit.

how_to_check.description: A concrete command, tabulation, or count the author can run to confirm or refute this in minutes.

suggested_fix.description: The change, specific enough to act on. Do not apply it yourself.

verified_clean.description: Things explicitly checked that were fine. This is what makes a short findings list trustworthy rather than lazy.

evidence.description: How it was confirmed, with path:line where applicable.

review_limits.description: What this review could NOT establish: data not readable, pipeline not runnable, paper text unavailable, Stata semantics not verifiable by reading. Be explicit; silence here reads as false assurance.
